proven: Coach and learner derive learning state and Next Best Action from the same authoritative learners/{uid} record.

findings.finding: Unauthorized access to Firestore by direct client is prevented by 403 status code.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for unauthenticated users.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for custom claims coach/admin/superuser.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for direct Firestore client.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for unauthorized or unavailable studio.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for dynamic persistent detail without coach.
Unauthorized access to coach API is prevented by 403 status code for static Mariana showcase.

remaining_boundaries: Role semantics are proven in Auth emulator; production claim provisioning is an operational authorization step.
release_recommendation: Proceed with caution, as the system relies on server-side verification of Firebase ID tokens and custom claims for coach access. Ensure that no unauthorized access points are introduced in the client-side coach API.
